description: Use this when the user asks whether a webhook or chat channel got a particular alert, why one is failing, or what was sent to it lately. Returns its latest deliveries, newest first: each one's event, when, whether it arrived, the HTTP status, how long it took, which attempt it was and, for a failure, what went wrong in a few words. Never the payload or what the endpoint answered. Not for the account's webhooks as a whole (use list_webhooks) or sending one again (use retry_webhook_delivery).

limit.description: How many deliveries, newest first. Default 20.

webhook.description: The webhook's id (from list_webhooks) or its name.

name: list_webhook_deliveries
title: List a webhook's deliveries
